title: TestWatchOnATerminalEndsHoldingForAPerson times out waiting for its first frame under host load
description:
In one loaded package run (the epic orchestrator, a plan-repair agent and two other tick gates on the host) the watch terminal test failed watchWaitsFor's 10s deadline with a fully empty stdout; it passes alone 3/3, in every other run including the full gate, and my changes touch none of its code. The watchWaitsFor deadline measures the host, not the tree — the w1j/cy2 family, worth one entry in their ledger rather than a pass per gate.

ticfac run epic-2jn filed this backlog tick from the finding e7711ee682433995ddb40ce43a10750682322cb3f279f38d847a7fb34327a68d (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-9sz/attempt-16): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/e7711ee682433995ddb40ce43a10750682322cb3f279f38d847a7fb34327a68d.json on the run branch.
